title: Turn Sales Calls into Clear Next Steps
summary: After each sales call, get a short brief of what the buyer needs and a clear next step to send.

money_potential.label: Low
money_potential.basis: Assumes you run your own sales calls; the value is next steps sent the same day.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labeled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Next steps go out the same day.
Fewer deals stall because nobody owned the follow-up.
who_its_for: Sales reps and founders who run their own calls.

stack.name: Sales Call Coach
stack.role: Reviews the call and points out what to improve.
stack.creator: Daniel Brill

stack.name: Meeting Brief
stack.role: Writes a short brief with the agreed next step.
stack.creator: Limok_igit

steps.name: Meeting Brief
steps.does: Writes the brief and next step

steps: Paste your call notes or transcript.
Check the brief and agreed next step.
guardrails: Check every claim against the call before you send it.
Never send a commitment the call did not agree.
